article.story: BUFFALO, N.Y. -- — Kahlil Singleton's 37 points led Canisius over Fairfield 85-81 on Friday. Singleton added five rebounds for the Golden Griffins (6-8, 1-2 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Bryan Ndjonga scored 18 points and added five rebounds. Myles Wilmoth had 13 points and 10 rebounds. Declan Wucherpfennig led the way for the Stags (8-7, 0-4) with 20 points. Brandon Benjamin added 19 points and 13 rebounds for Fairfield. Braden Sparks also recorded 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
